Occurrences.Kwic: 問龍女親獻佛未審將什麼獻
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (古尊宿語錄). Exact actor: the unnamed monk. An unnamed monk asks Zihu Lizong what the dragon girl personally offered Shakyamuni.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: 問 introduces the question about what the dragon girl offered; Zihu Lizong answers with a gesture.

Occurrences.Kwic: 彈指豁開多寶塔，呈珠龍女化全身。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (天界覺浪盛禪師全錄). Exact actor: Juelang Daosheng. Juelang’s verse says the jewel-presenting dragon girl transforms her whole body.
Source text (宗鏡錄). Exact actor: Yongming Yanshou. Yongming writes that the dragon girl presents the one mind as a jewel.

Occurrences.Kwic: 甚麼法大凡擔荷此事須是箇猛烈大丈夫始得所以京師俗諺云寧度百羅剎不度一迷邪如釋迦老子說華嚴經一生成佛只度得一箇善財童子說法華經只度得一箇娑竭羅龍女說大集經只度得一箇魔王說涅槃經只度得一箇廣額屠兒所謂殺人不眨眼底立地成佛立地成佛底殺人不眨眼且廣額屠兒來涅槃會上見佛說涅槃妙性忽然一念相應便證阿耨多羅三藐三菩提遂云世尊我是賢劫千佛一數釋迦老子曰善哉善
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (大慧普覺禪師普說). Exact actor: Dahui Zonggao. Dahui names the dragon girl as the one person brought to buddhahood in the Lotus scripture.

Occurrences.Kwic: 尼云：龍女八歲，南方無垢世界成等正覺，又作麼生？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (天聖廣燈錄). Exact actor: the unnamed nun. An unnamed nun cites the eight-year-old dragon girl becoming fully awakened in the southern stainless world.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: 尼云 explicitly assigns the dragon-girl precedent to an unnamed nun answering the master’s challenge.

Occurrences.Kwic: 若也會得，龍女立地成佛，南方無垢世界，只在萬安橋驀直轉灣；
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (雲溪俍亭挺禪師語錄). Exact actor: Langting Jingting. Langting says that if the address is understood, the dragon girl becomes a buddha on the spot.

RelatedMasters: 子湖山第一代神力禪師
Senses.Explanation: The dragon girl is the young female figure who presents a jewel and becomes a buddha immediately in the southern stainless world. Zihu Lizong is asked what she offered; Juelang Daosheng’s verse joins presentation of the jewel to transformation of her whole body. Dahui Zonggao cites her as the Lotus scripture’s single person brought to buddhahood, while an unnamed nun invokes her against a challenge based on the female body. Masters deploy the figure as a named precedent in public argument and verse, not as a generic dragon maiden.
